title: Why Carlos Sainz and Alex Albon remain cautious on long-awaited Williams upgrade package
paragraphs: On Thursday in Azerbaijan, Carlos Sainz and Alex Albon will finally be able to try the Williams FW48 upgrade package that has been in the pipeline since the start of the season. Aware that the car had some fundamental issues, the Grove team decided at an early stage to focus most of its R&D resources on one big hit, led by a revised and lighter chassis, along with a new aero package. title: What's going on with F1's uncertain final 2026 races
paragraphs: Preparations are being made at Imola in case Formula 1 needs to switch its season finale venue but the intention is to continue with races in Qatar and Abu Dhabi. F1 is waiting to see how events unfold in the Middle East given the ongoing conflict that forced the cancellation of the Bahrain and Saudi Arabian GPs earlier this year.
